procedure.name: Invoice Batch Reconciliation with ERP Purchase Orders
procedure.objective: Reconcile daily invoice batches with ERP purchase orders and flag unit variances
procedure.summary: Match received invoice line items to open ERP purchase orders, identify price/quantity variance, and route discrepancies.

scope.eligible_cases: Daily standard supplier invoices submitted via CSV

triggers: Daily AP batch import completion notification

boundaries.start: Opening reconciliation work queue in ERP Core Client
boundaries.end: Posting invoice adjustment batch or escalating variance

steps.label: Open Reconciliation Queue
steps.description: Navigate to AP queue and select active daily invoice batch
steps.expected_result: Batch line items display with pending status indicators

steps.label: Check Unit Variance
steps.description: Compare line item unit price with corresponding purchase order
steps.expected_result: Line item tagged as under or over tolerance threshold

variants.label: Bulk CSV Import Variant
variants.conditions: Supplier supports automated EDI line imports

exceptions.description: Purchase order status is closed or cancelled
exceptions.resolution: Route invoice line to supervisory exception queue

postconditions.description: Reconciliation batch posted and variance journal created in ERP

known_limitations: Requires manual supervisor review for line items over $1,000

questions.prompt: What threshold dictates escalation to supervisory queue for foreign currency lines?
